docs.title: Welcome to the Documentation of the Open Energy Metadata
Open Energy Metadata
docs.text:
Open Energy Metadata (OEMetadata) is an energy metadata standard including a metadata schema, templates, and examples. It is an extensive set of metadata based on the Frictionless Data Package specifications and the FAIR Principles.

The documentation is structured in three main sections: - Development Collaborative Development - Metadata Documentation Keys and Mappings - Code Documentation Install, Scripts, Tests

docs.title: MkDocs
docs.text: MkDocs is a fast and simple static site generator that is used for documentation. The source files are written in Markdown, and configured with a single YAML configuration file mkdocs.yml. Material theme enables additional features and an elegant design.

docs.title: Install
docs.text: Install the required packages in a python environment. pip install mkdocs install MkDocs pip install mkdocs-material install the material theme

docs.title: Build
docs.text: Generate the documentation. mkdocs serve start the local live version of the documentation mkdocs build create a folder site with the documentation

docs.title: Manually
docs.text: Publish documentation on GitHub Pages. mkdocs gh-deploy manually deploys the documentation files

docs.title: GitHub Action
docs.text: Deploy the documentation with GitHub Actions. The file .github\workflows\gh-pages.yml creates an automated GitHub workflow. It is configured to be pushed to the branch gh-page and then deployed online. A commit on the production branch triggers the workflow.

docs.title: Metadata Documentation
docs.text:
Open Energy Metadata (OEMetadata) is a metadata standard for the energy domain. It is an extensive set of metadata based on the Data Package Standard 2.0 and DCAT-AP 3.0 specifications. It is made to facilitate findability, accessibility, interoperability, and reusability (FAIR) of data. A badge system prioritises the keys and serves as a measure of the completeness and quality of the metadata entries.

The metadata schema is defined in JSON schema version 2020-12. The metadata contains keys in a nested JSON structure. The metadata standard includes the following files:

  • schema.json contains the complete metadata schema.
  • metadata_key_description.md contains a full description of each metadata key.
  • template.json contains an empty metadata string with all fields.
  • example.json contains a basic metadata example.

docs.title: OEMetadata - Key Description
docs.text: This pages describes the key of OEMetadata version 2.0 . You can have a look at an empty template and a filled out example of the metadata string. The schema.json contains the complete metadata schema.

docs.title: JSON Format
docs.text:
The JSON format offers different formats:

  • key-value pair: JSON {"key":"value"}
  • array: JSON {"key": ["value","value"]}
  • object {nested key}: JSON {"key": { "key_a":"value", "key_b":"value"}}
  • array of objects {nested array}: JSON {"key": [ {"key_a":"value"}, {"key_a":"value"}]}

docs.title: Cardinality
docs.text:
The cardinality defines the number of times an element can occur.

  • [1] Mandatory
  • [0..1] Optional
  • [*] Multiple optional
  • [1..*] Mandatory and multiple optional

docs.title: Badges
docs.text: Badges indicate the priority of metadata keys. They are implemented as part of the Open Peer Review Process.

docs.title: Additional information:
docs.text: If a field is not applicable use: null. If a value is not yet available, use: ToDo.

docs.title: Resource - embargoPeriod (end)
docs.text: Key end Description The end date of the embargo period. This is the envisioned publication date. Example 2025-01-01 Ontology Class dbo:endDateTime Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - embargoPeriod (isActive)
docs.text: Key isActive Description A boolean key that indicates if the embargo period is currently active. Must be changed to False on the embargo period end date. Example True Ontology Class adms:status Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - context
docs.text: Key context Description An object that describes the general setting, environment, or project leading to the creation or maintenance of this dataset. In science, this can be the research project. Example Ontology Class Badge Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - context (title)
docs.text: Key title Description A title of the associated project. Example NFDI4Energy Ontology Class dct:title Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - context (homepage)
docs.text: Key homepage Description A URL of the project. Example nfdi4energy.uol.de Ontology Class foaf:homepage Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - context (documentation)
docs.text: Key documentation Description A URL of the project documentation. Example nfdi4energy.uol.de/sites/about_us Ontology Class ncit:Project Description Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - context (sourceCode)
docs.text: Key sourceCode Description A URL of the source code of the project. Example github.com/NFDI4Energy Ontology Class oeo:code source Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - context (publisher)
docs.text: Key publisher Description The publishing agency of the data. This can be the OEP. Example Open Energy Platform (OEP) Ontology Class dct:publisher Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - context (publisherLogo)
docs.text: Key publisherLogo Description A URL to the logo of the publishing agency of data. Example OpenEnergyFamily_Logo_OpenEnergyPlatform.svg Ontology Class foaf:logo Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - context (contact)
docs.text: Key contact Description A reference to the creator or maintainer of the data set. It can be an email address or a GitHub handle. Example info@nfdi4energy.org Ontology Class oeo:contact person Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - context (fundingAgency)
docs.text: Key fundingAgency Description A name of the entity providing the funding. This can be a government agency or a company. Example Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG) Ontology Class sc:FundingAgency Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - context (fundingAgencyLogo)
docs.text: Key fundingAgencyLogo Description A URL to the logo or image of the funding agency. Example DFG-logo-blau.svg Ontology Class foaf:logo Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - context (grantNo)
docs.text: Key grantNo Description An identifying grant number. In case of a publicly funded project, this number is assigned by the funding agency. Example 501865131 Ontology Class sc:Grant Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - spatial
docs.text: Key spatial Description An object that describes the spatial context of the data. Example Ontology Class Badge Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - spatial (location)
docs.text: Key location Description An object that describes a specific location. Example Ontology Class dct:location Badge Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - spatial (location - address)
docs.text: Key address Description An address of the location of the data. May be specified with street name, house number, zip code, and city name. Example Rudower Chaussee 12, 12489 Berlin Ontology Class schema:address Badge Silver Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - spatial (location - @id)
docs.text: Key @id Description A path or URI to a specific location. It can use Wikidata or OpenStreetMap. Example www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q77077223 Ontology Class dct:identifier Badge Platinum Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - spatial (location - latitude)
docs.text: Key latitude Description The latitude (lat) information of the location. Example 52.432822 Ontology Class schema:latitude Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - spatial (location - longitude)
docs.text: Key longitude Description The longitude (lon) information of the location. Example 13.5351004 Ontology Class schema:longitude Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - spatial (extent)
docs.text: Key extent Description An object that describes a covered area or region. Example Ontology Class oeo:spatial region Badge Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - spatial (extent - name)
docs.text: Key name Description The name of the region. Example Berlin Ontology Class rdfs:label Badge Silver Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - spatial (extent - @id)
docs.text: Key @id Description A URI reference for the region. Example www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q64 Ontology Class dct:identifier Badge Platinum Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - spatial (extent - resolutionValue)
docs.text: Key resolutionValue Description The value of the spatial resolution. Example 100 Ontology Class dcat:spatialResolutionInMeters Badge Silver Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - spatial (extent - resolutionUnit)
docs.text: Key resolutionUnit Description The unit of the spatial resolution. Example m Ontology Class oeo:unit Badge Silver Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - spatial (extent - boundingBox)
docs.text: Key boundingBox Description The covered area specified by the coordinates of a bounding box. The format is [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] or [W,S,E,N]. Example [13.08825, 52.33859, 13.76104, 52.6754] Ontology Class dcat:bbox Badge Gold Card. [*]

docs.title: Resource - spatial (extent - crs)
docs.text: Key crs Description The Coordinate Reference System, specified as an EPSG code. Example EPSG:4326 Ontology Class cco:Geospatial Coordinate Reference System Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - temporal
docs.text: Key temporal Description An object with the time period covered in the data. Temporal information should contain a "referenceDate" or the keys that describe a time series, or both. Example Ontology Class schema:temporalCoverage Badge Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - temporal (referenceDate)
docs.text: Key referenceDate Description A base year, month or day. The time for which the data should be accurate. Date Format is ISO 8601. Example 2020-01-01 Ontology Class dct:date Badge Silver Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - temporal (timeseries)
docs.text: Key timeseries Description An array that describes the timeseries. Example Ontology Class dct:PeriodOfTime Badge Card. [*]

docs.title: Resource - temporal (timeseries - start)
docs.text: Key start Description The start time of a time series. Example 2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00 Ontology Class dbo:startDateTime Badge Silver Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - temporal (timeseries - end)
docs.text: Key end Description The temporal end point of a time series. Example 2020-01-01T23:59:30+00:00 Ontology Class dbo:endDateTime Badge Silver Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - temporal (timeseries - resolutionValue)
docs.text: Key resolutionValue Description The time span between individual information points in a time series. The value of the resolution. Example 30 s Ontology Class dcat:spatialResolutionInMeters Badge Silver Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - temporal (timeseries - resolutionUnit)
docs.text: Key resolutionUnit Description The unit of the temporal resolution. Example 30 s Ontology Class oeo:unit Badge Silver Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - temporal (timeseries - alignment)
docs.text: Key alignment Description An indicator of whether timestamps in a time series are to the left, right or in the centre. Example left Ontology Class oeo:time stamp alignment Badge Silver Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - temporal (timeseries - aggregationType)
docs.text: Key aggregationType Description An indicator of whether the values are a sum, an average or a current value. Example current Ontology Class oeo:aggregation type Badge Silver Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - sources
docs.text: Key sources Description An array of objects with the used and underlying sources of the data and metadata. Example Ontology Class dct:source Badge Card. [*]

docs.title: Resource - sources (title)
docs.text: Key title Description A human readable title of the source, a document title or organisation name. Example IPCC Sixth Assessment Report (AR6) - Climate Change 2023 - Synthesis Report Ontology Class dct:title Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - sources (authors)
docs.text: Key authors Description An array of the full names of the authors of the source material. Example Hoesung Lee, José Romero, The Core Writing Team Ontology Class oeo:author Badge Bronze Card. [*]

docs.title: Resource - sources (description)
docs.text: Key description Description A free text description of the source. Example A Report of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change Ontology Class dct:description Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - sources (publicationYear)
docs.text: Key publicationYear Description Indicates the year when the work was published. Example 2023 Ontology Class dct:issued Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - sources (path)
docs.text: Key path Description A DOI or link to the original source. Example IPCC_AR6_SYR_FullVolume.pdf Ontology Class sc:url Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - sourceLicenses
docs.text: Key sourceLicenses Description An array of objects of licenses under which the described source is provided. See academy/courses/08_licensing for further information. Example Ontology Class dct:license Badge Card. [*]

docs.title: Resource - sourceLicenses (name)
docs.text: Key name Description The SPDX identifier. Example ODbL-1.0 Ontology Class rdfs:label Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - sourceLicenses (title)
docs.text: Key title Description The official (human-readable) title of the license. Example Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0 Ontology Class dct:title Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - sourceLicenses (path)
docs.text: Key path Description A link or path to the license text. Example opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/index.html Ontology Class sc:url Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - sourceLicenses (instruction)
docs.text: Key instruction Description A short description of rights and obligations. The use of tl;drLegal is recommended. Example You are free to share and change, but you must attribute, and share derivations under the same license. See tldrlegal.com for further information. Ontology Class rdfs:comment Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - sourceLicenses (attribution)
docs.text: Key attribution Description A copyright owner of the source. Must be provided if attribution licenses are used. Example © Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change 2023 Ontology Class ms:copyright notice Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - sourceLicenses (copyrightStatement)
docs.text: Key copyrightStatement Description A link or path that proves that the source or data has the appropriate license. This can be a page number or website imprint. Example www.ipcc.ch/copyright Ontology Class dct:rights Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - licenses
docs.text: Key licenses Description An array of objects of licenses under which the described data is provided. Example Ontology Class dct:license Badge Card. [*]

docs.title: Resource - licenses (name)
docs.text: Key name Description The SPDX identifier. Example ODbL-1.0 Ontology Class rdfs:label Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - licenses (title)
docs.text: Key title Description The official (human-readable) title of the license. Example Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0 Ontology Class dct:title Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - licenses (path)
docs.text: Key path Description A link or path to the license text. Example opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/index.html Ontology Class dcat:accessURL Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - licenses (instruction)
docs.text: Key instruction Description A short description of rights and obligations. The use of tl;drLegal is recommended. Example You are free to share and change, but you must attribute, and share derivations under the same license. See tldrlegal.com for further information. Ontology Class dc:rights Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - licenses (attribution)
docs.text: Key attribution Description A copyright owner of the data. Must be provided if attribution licenses are used. Example © Reiner Lemoine Institut Ontology Class spdx:attributionText Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - licenses (copyrightStatement)
docs.text: Key copyrightStatement Description A link or path that proves that the data has the appropriate license. This can be a page number or website imprint. Example www.ipcc.ch/copyright/ Ontology Class dct:rights Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Provenance Keys
docs.text: Key contributors Description An array of objects of the people or organizations who contributed to the data or metadata. Should have "Date of data creation" and "Date of metadata creation" Example Ontology Class foaf:Agent Badge Card. [*]

docs.title: Resource - Provenance Keys (title)
docs.text: Key title Description A full name of the contributor. Example Ludwig Hülk Ontology Class dct:title Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Provenance Keys (path)
docs.text: Key path Description A qualified link or path pointing to a relevant location online for the contributor. This can be the GitHub page or ORCID. Example https://github.com/Ludee Ontology Class sc:url Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Provenance Keys (organization)
docs.text: Key organization Description A string describing the organization this contributor is affiliated to. This can be relevant for the copyright. Example Reiner Lemoine Institut Ontology Class oeo:organisation Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Provenance Keys (roles)
docs.text: Key roles Description An array describing the roles of the contributor. A role is recommended to follow the established vocabulary: DataCite Metadata Schema’s contributorRole. Example DataCollector, DataCurator Ontology Class oeo:role Badge Bronze Card. [*]

docs.title: Resource - Provenance Keys (date)
docs.text: Key date Description The date of the contribution. Date Format is ISO 8601. Example 2024-10-21 Ontology Class dct:issued Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Provenance Keys (object)
docs.text: Key object Description The target of the contribution. This can be the data, the metadata or both (data and metadata). Example data and metadata Ontology Class dct:type Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Provenance Keys (comment)
docs.text: Key comment Description A free-text commentary on what has been done. Example Add general context. Ontology Class rdfs:comment Badge Bronze Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Type Keys
docs.text: Key type Description The 'table' type indicates that the resource is tabular as per 'Frictionless Tabular Data' definition. Example table Ontology Class csvw:datatype Badge Gold Card. [0..1] Key format Description A file extension format. Possible options are 'csv', 'xlsx', 'json', 'PostgreSQL', 'SQLite' and other standard file extensions. Example PostgreSQL Ontology Class dct:format Badge Gold Card. [0..1] Key encoding Description Specifies the character encoding of the resource's data file. The default is 'UTF-8'. The values should be one of the 'Preferred MIME Names'. Example UTF-8 Ontology Class csvw:encoding Badge Gold Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys
docs.text: Key schema Description An object that describes the structure of a table. It contains all fields (columns of the table), the primary key and optional foreign keys. Example Ontology Class schema:table Badge Card. [1]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys - fields
docs.text: Key fields Description An array of objects that describes a field (column) and its detailed information. Example Ontology Class csvw:column Badge Card. [1]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys - name
docs.text: Key name Description The name of the field. The name may only consist of lowercase alphanumeric characters or underscores. It must not begin with a number or an underscore. Example year Ontology Class rdfs:label Badge Iron Card. [1]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys - description
docs.text: Key description Description A text describing the field. Example Reference year for which the data were collected. Ontology Class dct:description Badge Silver Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys - type
docs.text: Key type Description The data type of the field. In case of a geom column in a database, also indicate the shape and CRS. Example geometry(Point, 4326) Ontology Class csvw:datatype Badge Iron Card. [1]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys - nullable
docs.text: Key nullable Description A boolean key to specify that a column can be nullable. True is the default value. Example True Ontology Class ncit:null Badge Iron Card. [1]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys - unit
docs.text: Key unit Description The unit of a field. If it does not apply, use 'null'. If the unit is given in a separate field, reference this field (e.g. 'unit'). Use a space between numbers and units (100 m). Example MW Ontology Class oeo:has unit Badge Silver Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys - isAbout
docs.text: Key isAbout Description An array of objects that describes the field in ontology terms. Example Ontology Class sc:about Badge Card. [*]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys - name (isAbout)
docs.text: Key name Description The class label of the ontology term. Example wind energy converting unit Ontology Class rdfs:label Badge Platinum Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys - @id (isAbout)
docs.text: Key @id Description The path of the ontology term (IRI). Example OEO_00000044 Ontology Class dct:identifier Badge Platinum Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys - valueReference
docs.text: Key valueReference Description An array of objects for an extended description of the values in the column in ontology terms. Example Ontology Class prov:value Badge Card. [*]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys - value
docs.text: Key value Description The name of the value in the column. Example onshore Ontology Class rdf:value Badge Platinum Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys - name (valueReference)
docs.text: Key name Description The class label of the ontology term in the column. Example onshore wind farm Ontology Class rdfs:label Badge Platinum Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Fields Keys - @id (valueReference)
docs.text: Key @id Description The path of the ontology term (IRI) in the column. Example OEO_00000311 Ontology Class dct:identifier Badge Platinum Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Properties Keys
docs.text: Key primaryKey Description An array of fields that uniquely identifies each row in the table. The default value is the “id” column. Example id Ontology Class csvw:primaryKey Badge Iron Card. [1..*]

docs.title: Resource - Properties Keys - foreignKeys
docs.text: Key foreignKeys Description An array of objects with foreign keys that describe a field that relates to a field in another table. Example Ontology Class csvw:foreignKey Badge Card. [*]

docs.title: Resource - Properties Keys - fields (foreignKeys)
docs.text: Key fields Description An array of fields in the table that is constrained by the foreign key. Example id, version Ontology Class ex:nestedFields Badge Iron Card. [*]

docs.title: Resource - Properties Keys - reference
docs.text: Key reference Description The reference to the foreign table. Example Ontology Class Badge Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Properties Keys - resource (reference)
docs.text: Key resource Description The referenced foreign table. Example model_draft.oep_oemetadata_table_example_version Ontology Class dcat:Dataset Badge Iron Card. [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Properties Keys - fields (reference)
docs.text: Key fields Description The foreign resource column. Example id, version Ontology Class csvw:column Badge Iron Card. [*]

docs.title: Resource - Properties Keys - dialect
docs.text: Key dialect Description The Dialect defines a simple format for describing the various dialects of CSV files in a language-independent manner. In a database, the values in the fields are 'null'. Example Ontology Class Badge Card. [1]

docs.title: Resource - Properties Keys - delimiter
docs.text: Key delimiter Description The delimiter specifies the character sequence which should separate fields (columns). Common characters are ',' (comma), ';' (semicolon), '.' (point) and '\t' (tab). Example , Ontology Class csvw:delimiter Badge Iron Card. [1]

docs.title: Resource - Properties Keys - decimalSeparator
docs.text: Key decimalSeparator Description The symbol used to separate the integer part from the fractional part of a number written in decimal form. Depending on language and region this symbol can be '.' or ','. Example . Ontology Class csvw:decimalChar Badge Iron Card. [1]

docs.title: Resource - Review Keys
docs.text: Key review Description The metadata on the OEP can go through an open peer review process. See the Academy course Open Peer Review for further information. Example Ontology Class Badge [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Review Keys - path
docs.text: Key path Description A link or path to the documented open peer review. Example open_peer_review/9 Ontology Class sc:url Badge [0..1]

docs.title: Resource - Review Keys - badge
docs.text: Key badge Description A badge of either Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold or Platinum is used to label the quality of the metadata. Example Platinum Ontology Class oeo:quality control flag Badge [0..1]

docs.title: MetaMetadata Keys
docs.text: Key metaMetadata Description An object that describes the metadata themselves, their format, version and license. Example Ontology Class Card. [1]

docs.title: MetaMetadata Keys - metadataVersion
docs.text: Key metadataVersion Description Type and version number of the metadata. Example OEMetadata-2.0 Ontology Class owl:versionInfo Card. [1]

docs.title: MetaMetadata Keys - metadataLicense
docs.text: Key metadataLicense Description The license of the provided metadata. Example Ontology Class dct:license Card. [1]

docs.title: MetaMetadata Keys - metadataLicense - name
docs.text: Key name Description The SPDX identifier. Example CC0-1.0 Ontology Class rdfs:label Card. [1]

docs.title: MetaMetadata Keys - metadataLicense - title
docs.text: Key title Description The official (human-readable) title of the license. Example Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal Ontology Class dct:title Card. [1]

docs.title: MetaMetadata Keys - metadataLicense - path
docs.text: Key path Description A link or path to the license text. Example creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ Ontology Class sc:url Card. [1]
